analysis.title: US Equities Mid-Day Color - 17 Nov 2026
key_insights: Markets are choppy and trending lower after a retail sales print of +0.2% M/M against an estimate of +0.1%, ahead of NVDA earnings after the close. 403 SPX names are lower and all 11 sectors are in the red.
Headline risk during the session: CNN reported that an NSA internal communications system is down, and the WSJ reported that Jensen Huang has signaled willingness to return as NVDA CEO.

GS's Long AI vs Short AI at Risk basket (GSPUARTI) outperformed by +110bps even though many AI themes fell: AI semis -138bps, hyperscalers -147bps, memory -100bps, neoclouds -60bps, data centers -45bps.

Options imply an 8% NVDA move on the print. NVDA has shed $2T of market cap since mid-October and GS rates positioning a 7/10. Investors still expect a beat and raise against consensus Oct-quarter revenue of $109B with broadly stable gross margins.
Investors will watch for any update to prior CY27 commentary (>70% revenue growth), changes to capital return (last quarter included a $20bn share repurchase), and broader AI industry comments.
Liquidity is poor: market volumes are +10% vs the 20-day average, ETFs are 37% of the tape (vs 28% YTD average), and top-of-book liquidity is $3.9MM, down 52% vs the 20-day average.

GS desk flows: floor activity is 3 out of 10 and net slightly better for sale. Long-only funds are 11% better for sale and selling tech, with supply in consumer discretionary and industrials. Hedge funds are 4% better to buy, with demand in tech and healthcare and supply in industrials, communication services and financials.

Chart of the Day (GIR): the S&P 500 has returned 120% (21% annualized) since the late-2022 bull market start, the strongest four-year return in 50 years outside the Dot-Com Bubble and post-recession recoveries.
earnings_insights: NVDA reports after the close on 11/17. Consensus Oct-quarter revenue is $109B (estimate, not yet reported), with broadly stable gross margins expected. Options imply an 8% move.
NVDA prior-quarter capital return: $20bn share repurchase in the quarter (reported). Investors are watching for changes to capital return ambitions.
NVDA prior CY27 commentary of >70% revenue growth is a focus for reiteration or update.
Consumer bellwethers AS, HD and VIK report over the next few days, per GS Consumer note.
